result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.delete_node()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Delete a node from the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L706-L775){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.delete_node(node) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Removes a node and all its incident edges from the graph. The node can be specified by its ID or label. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node ID (int) or label (str) to delete. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Returns self to enable method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the node doesn't exist in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Delete node by label: ::: {#e6cbfbe1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 2 Directed : False Density : 0.67 Average degree (min, max) : 1.33 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: ::: {#306bb801 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.delete_node(node="B") # Node B no longer exists graph.has_node(node="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` False ``` ::: ::: Delete node by ID: ::: {#7ac219a2 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph().add_node(label="Alice") node_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="Alice") graph.delete_node(node=node_id) # Node no longer exists graph.has_node(node=node_id) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` False ``` ::: :::
